item.title: Daily Minute — November 8, 2026
item.description:
If you are fearful, it is certain that you will endow the world with attributes which it does not possess, and crowd it with images that do not exist. To the ego illusions are safety devices, as they must also be to you who equate yourself with the ego.

item.title: Lesson 130: “It is impossible to see two worlds.”
item.description: “It is impossible to see two worlds.” Perception is consistent. What you see reflects your thinking. And your thinking but reflects your choice of what you want to see.Your values are determiners of this, for what you value you must want to see, believing what you see is really there. No-one can see a world his mind has not accorded value.And no-one can fail to look upon what he believes he wants.
